labels.support: claim = a core abstract sentence; evidence = the abstract fragment that contains it
labels.partial: claim = full core sentence; evidence = only one assertion clause of it, so the evidence supports part of the claim
labels.contradict: claim = the sentence with one assertion flipped to its antonym; evidence = the original sentence
labels.no_evidence: claim = core sentence of paper B; evidence = sentence(s) of a different, unrelated paper A

labeling_note: Labels are fully determined by the construction rules above; there is NO human double annotation and NO kappa. A 20% (20/100) construction-rule re-check is recorded in claimsupport_cn.spot_check.json (single-annotator review).

source.note: Claim/evidence are short Chinese fragments derived from OpenAlex Chinese-language abstracts (some abstracts are OpenAlex automatic translations). Full abstracts are not re-hosted.
